key_insight: Func-R1 tackles a key failure mode in multimodal math reasoning: models can compute textually but still ignore or misread visual function cues.
engineering_relevance: The paper shows that decoupling perception from reasoning and aligning policy updates to visual evidence can materially improve MLLM performance on function-based math tasks.
method: Uses an explicitly decoupled architecture to separate visual perception from symbolic reasoning.
Applies a hierarchical post-training pipeline to first identify critical visual evidence, then perform deeper theoretical reasoning.
Introduces Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization (PATO) to correct heterogeneous visual inputs while internalizing function-theory properties.
evidence_signal: The authors report extensive benchmark gains, including the best performance among open-source MLLMs and an 8.4% improvement over GPT-5 on MathVerse function-oriented tasks.
watch_item: Results depend on careful visual evidence selection and post-training design, so performance may be sensitive to domain shift or weaker image-grounding quality.
paper_title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
